message:
So `xmlParseDocument` calls `xmlDetectSAX2(ctxt)` which sets `sax2`. But `xmlParseElement` is called unconditionally regardless of `sax2`. Let me check if `xmlParseElement` is only called when `sax2` is true:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "sax2" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/parser.c | grep -i "xmlParseElement\|xmlParseContent" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
